page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CL processors. The instance is configured with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

The hardware profile of the ecs.re6.16xlarge makes it highly cost-efficient for workloads requiring massive memory footprints relative to compute resources. By providing a dense memory allocation of 16 GB per vCPU, the instance allows organizations to run large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, and real-time data processing engines without paying for unnecessary CPU cores. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, though the lack of local NVMe storage requires careful consideration of network storage latency for I/O-heavy applications.

This instance is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale SAP HANA deployments, in-memory databases like Redis or Memcached, big data analytics, and heavy caching layers.
